digest.component_or_area: gate dispatch and container staging (LLM workflow error handling)
propositions: Three defensive exception-handling arms deciding LLM-tier failure abort vs. degrade behavior have zero test coverage despite being reachable in production (plan-review and container paths) or defensive seam contracts (code-review).

Plan-review mid-run arm in gate_dispatch._ex.run_workflow is production-reachable via batch-runner raw exception propagation through ProductionBatchRunner and container warm-call abort, but mutation testing confirms the LLMInputRejectedError branch is untested.

Code-review mid-run arm in gate_dispatch is a defensive seam contract at run_workflow boundary; its reachability is unprovable in current codebase (systemic errors are translated upstream), so it should be pinned as test-as-contract rather than removed.

Container warm-call abort in container_stage._run_container raises both LLMUnavailableError and LLMInputRejectedError to block fan-out, but the LLMInputRejectedError branch has no direct test coverage.

Batch-runner exceptions propagate raw out of run_workflow with no intermediate try/catch (_run_batch has no exception handler), making mid-run arms reachable despite agent-step path absorbing exceptions into StepResult.

New test coverage must verify both exception types trigger degraded INDETERMINATE verdict with gate_error sidecar emission (plan/code review) and abort the fan-out without degradation (container warm call).
